title: Distinguish the KB, its root and its evolutions

nodes.summary: KnowledgeBase aggregates one accepted root and lazily loaded workspaces
nodes.detail: A KnowledgeBase is a repository-scoped aggregate with one accepted root and a collection of evolution workspaces; opening the KB must not eagerly load every workspace. Rejects a universal mutable Kb of paths, callbacks and current values.

realised.evidence: KnowledgeBase and EvolutionWorkspace first appear in code in PR #31 (KB/workspace/context values)

nodes.summary: Host Root is an opaque snapshot handle, distinct from guest Root
nodes.detail: The host Root is an opaque descriptor of schema, fact snapshot and code snapshot (including vendored deps, examples, config and query/output declarations) created by host stores as handles to fixed contents, never editable paths. The guest's Root is a different, KB-authored data type.

realised.evidence: Store-created opaque handles were never built; replaced by immutable file-tree values at seq 4 before any code existed

nodes.summary: Workspace has Before revision, target After, evaluated Candidate Root
nodes.detail: An EvolutionWorkspace's Before holds a Git revision and its schema; After specifies only the target schema; evaluation yields Candidate Root and checking yields Candidate (Validated Root). CheckedEvolution groups these for acceptance as an ordinary checked value, not an approval token; archives keep metadata without loading typed roots.

realised.evidence: Workspace capture against Before in #31, Candidate persistence/checking in #37; CheckedEvolution name itself never appears in code

nodes.summary: Candidate is a Functor over payload; Validated has no Functor
nodes.detail: Candidate carries a captured evolution context and fixed report and fmap maps only its payload; Validated has no Functor, so no mapping carries a validation result onto changed content. Changing a proposed root requires fresh evaluation and checking.

realised.evidence: PR #37: Candidate is ordinary Functor data preserving context and report; checkCandidate composes checkRoot

nodes.summary: Validated constructor private to porcelain validation-owned module
nodes.detail: Validated lives in a non-public validation module in kyyn-porcelain beside the checker that constructs it; consumers get only the abstract type, enforced by package/import checks. Ordinary fact reads require an explicit Validated Root.

realised.evidence: PR #28 adds Validation/Types with private constructor and import-check rejection of constructor imports

nodes.summary: KnowledgeBase is explicit repository plus KB-relative prefix
nodes.detail: KnowledgeBase becomes a concrete record of Repository and a KB-relative directory prefix so publication can address the selected KB without guessing its location.

realised.evidence: KnowledgeBase record introduced in PR #31 (Repository in code from seq 19)

nodes.summary: Fact and code snapshots are immutable file-tree values
nodes.detail: FactSnapshot and CodeSnapshot contain immutable file-tree values read into memory at load; later reads never resolve editable paths or depend on a store-specific handle service. The host/guest Root distinction is retained.

realised.evidence: PR #17 introduces RootStore materialization/reopening over immutable FileTree values; Root holds facts/code as FileTree

nodes.summary: Root schema is the persistent-root RootContract refinement
nodes.detail: Root.schema takes RootContract, a private refinement of the general checked value contract that enforces persistent-root layout, so query values need not satisfy root collection rules.

realised.evidence: PR #26 adds RootContract/checkRootLayout and changes Root.schema

nodes.summary: checkRoot is the sole Validated Root path; validatedValue accessor
nodes.detail: checkRoot (ADR 0011) is the constructor-owning route to Validated Root; validatedValue exposes the payload without constructor or mapping, and saved reports never bypass checking.

realised.evidence: PR #28 implements checkRoot as only constructor of the private Validated wrapper

nodes.summary: Dependency-free public Kyyn.Porcelain.Validated facade exports abstract type
nodes.detail: A public module exports only the abstract Validated type and validatedValue, importing neither checker nor constructor, so store capabilities can use it without an import cycle.

realised.evidence: PR #29 adds Kyyn/Porcelain/Validated.hs facade and import checks

nodes.summary: KB prefix is TreePath; stores derive root/ and evolutions/
nodes.detail: The prefix is WholeTree or a nonempty Subtree, and stores derive root/ and evolutions/<id>/ beneath it rather than accepting independently selected root or workspace paths.

realised.evidence: PR #31 KnowledgeBase uses TreePath (type existed from seq 21); EvolutionStore derives workspace paths

nodes.summary: Root carries a separate host-owned curation register
nodes.detail: The host Root gains a CurationRegister field holding curation progress, which is neither guest domain data nor authored code.

realised.evidence: PR #112: Root carries a distinct typed register, preserved across capture/candidate/export

nodes.summary: Root carries recipes as authored facts; guest gets KnowledgeBase wrapper
nodes.detail: Recipes become authored knowledge held in the root as [Fact Recipe], distinct from progress bookkeeping; the guest evolution receives a typed KnowledgeBase wrapper, not the host snapshot descriptor.

realised.evidence: PR #118 'Evolve recipes as first-class knowledge-base data' implements #116 design

nodes.summary: Root holds stored recipes with typed state; no curation register
nodes.detail: The host Root drops the curation register and holds [StoredRecipe]: recipe definitions with independently typed per-recipe state, both authored knowledge in the accepted root.

realised.evidence: PR #210 adds StoredRecipe and removes CurationRegister; Root now has recipes :: [Fact StoredRecipe]

editorial.note: Also converts status line to front-matter metadata and an established/proposed basis statement; no architectural change
Implementation-status note: Candidate now implemented as Functor data with checkCandidate; restates 0004.04 rather than changing it

Desired-state reconciliation: removes status/date/basis metadata and 'implemented'/'unimplemented' status prose, rewords query/output declarations as authored functions and registrations; all covered by existing nodes

notes: Lane is mostly stable at the KB/Root/Candidate/Validated level; nearly all change is to the shape of the host Root record. The biggest detour is the recipe/curation arc: a host-owned CurationRegister was added (seq 91), recipes moved into the root as facts (seq 94, built 96), and the whole register was then removed in favour of typed per-recipe state (seq 158, built 162) within two weeks. CheckedEvolution, FactSnapshot and CodeSnapshot never became code names (Root uses FileTree; acceptance composes AcceptEvolution), so 0004.03's realisation is judged by behaviour not identifiers. The Boundaries and consequences section (fact reads need Validated Root, accepted-root loading re-checks) was folded into 0004.05 rather than given nodes; seq 143 quietly dropped 'Accepted-load composition remains unimplemented' without evidence it had been built.
